thread:
Maya - Finance: Following up from today's all-hands Q&A on runway and spend controls. Key points: aiming for ~14 months runway; hiring pause in effect for noncritical roles; p-card limit $5k; PO for >$5k; exceptions reviewed weekly. Full slides: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/q2_finance_deck :point_right:

Darren - Eng: Quick one: Dedicated GPU commitments — are these booked as OPEX? Who signs off?

Maya - Finance: Yes, treat reserved capacity as OPEX/contracted services. Approvals: cost owner + eng lead + finance. Purchases >$50k need finance director review. DM me the SOW and I'll route it.

Priya - Product: Vendor work for customer SLAs — push or exception?

Raj - CFO: If vendor work is customer-committed or revenue-linked, submit exception with ROI. Otherwise we either delay or reduce scope.

Sam - Infra: We have a 48h pretraining spike coming. Can we pre-authorize?

Maya - Finance: Yes — submit Temporary Budget form with ceiling, dates, approvers, and rollback plan. Approvals: infra manager + eng lead + finance ops. For emergencies open an emergency spend ticket and tag #finance-oncall.

Elena - People Ops: Clarify signing bonus / relocation during pause?

Maya - Finance: Signing bonuses up to $5k ok with manager + People Ops. Larger exceptions require director approval. Use the comp-exception form.

procure-bot: Reminder: attach vendor quote, SOW, and recent invoice to procurement requests. Missing docs delay processing.

Darren - Eng: Can finance publish a one-page cheat sheet for common flows (p-card, PO, temporary budget, emergency)? Teams keep asking.

Maya - Finance: Will do — one-pager ETA Friday. Quick matrix for now:
< $5k -> p-card
$5k-$50k -> PO via procurement form
> $50k -> PO + finance director review
Dedicated capacity -> contract route (OPEX approvals)
Emergency -> emergency spend ticket + finance-oncall

Maya - Finance: Action items: 1) Post one-pager + temp budget checklist in #docs by EOD Fri. 2) Weekly exception review Fridays. 3) DM me for expedited reviews. Closing thread; DM for urgent items. :white_check_mark:
